Certainly! Here are two hints for the given problem:

Hint 1: Consider the properties of L1 regularization (also known as Lasso) and how it affects the uniqueness of the solution in a linear regression model. Think about the conditions under which L1 regularization provides a unique solution.

Hint 2: Recall that L1 regularization introduces sparsity in the model parameters. Reflect on how this sparsity might influence the uniqueness of the solution, especially when the number of features is close to the number of observations.
